acceptance_conditions: Use only authentication-free official ONS or UK government catalogue, API and downloadable postcode assets
Inspect ONS Open Geography Portal catalogue metadata without relying on a single ArcGIS owner filter
Discover and checksum bounded NSPL or ONS Postcode Directory CSV, ZIP or equivalent official packages
Record official URL, access time, licence or attribution, package checksum and manifest rows
Extract only exact postcode records containing explicit 2011 and 2021 LSOA fields or documented official crosswalk fields
Execute bounded catalogue and package work with at most 15 workers and at most 4 simultaneous large downloads
Postcode proximity, centroid containment, majority voting and nearby-row inference cannot promote the parcel
Promotion requires an exact non-derived parent source-to-postcode binding and at least two agreeing official releases
Unavailable or unsuitable official assets are recorded fail-closed and do not become fabricated evidence
Publish catalogue, package, checksum, exact-row, provenance and decision operations line-by-line on the website
Update JSON, HTML, status, evidence, queue and manual-action files
Canonical rebase/push and remote hash readback must succeed when the task is executed
